free_tier.stated: Totally free forever. Try it out. See what it can do. Always $0 25MB 1 Proxy
free_tier.notes: The free Developer plan is 25 MB of cache, one proxy server and 10 connections, with no end date stated (the price column reads 'Always').

per_object_cap.stated: no per-item size cap is published on the pricing page; the plan's 25 MB is the whole cache

retention.stated: data lives in the Memcached cache until evicted or the cache is restarted; no automatic expiry schedule is stated on the pricing page
retention.notes: Memcached is an in-memory cache; retention is governed by eviction, not a published day count.

egress.terms: no egress allowance or per-GB price is published on the pricing page

interface_detail: the Memcached text protocol is the service interface; the pricing and signup pages checked do not publish an API reference, so the programmatic interface is documented from the product category and not from a captured protocol page
tooling: standard Memcached clients that speak the Memcached text protocol, connecting to the single proxy
chaining: a free MemCachier cache can sit in front of a separate free database to offload reads; the 25 MB cache and 10 connections bound any chain immediately

limits.value: 25 MB of cache storage on the Developer plan
1 proxy server on the Developer plan

binding_note: the 25 MB cache size fills well before the 10-connection limit for a single application, so storage binds first

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for Email address and Password and is protected by reCAPTCHA. No card, phone or ID document is requested on the free sign-up page.

reliability_note: the free Developer plan has one proxy server and no high availability, so the single proxy is the availability of the cache; basic analytics only
confidence_note: the plan numbers and sign-up fields are from first-party pages read today; no probe was run, so the rung stays documented
